# Anthropic Managed Agents — permission policies (literal)
# Captured 2026-10-11 from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/permission-policies

POLICY TYPES:
  always_allow  tool executes automatically, no confirmation
  always_ask    session pauses, waits for client approval
  auto          server evaluates EACH call -> runs it, denies it, or pauses for approval

DEFAULTS PER TOOLSET KIND:
  agent_toolset_20260401   always_allow     <-- built-in tools incl. bash run ungated by default
  MCP toolsets             always_ask

SET AT: agent `tools[].default_config.permission_policy`
PER-TOOL OVERRIDE: tools[].configs[] with `name` (MCP: the tool name the MCP server reports)
NOT GOVERNED: custom tools (executed by the customer's application)

SCOPE: running sessions keep the toolset config they were created with; updates apply only to
sessions created afterward.

`auto` OUTCOMES on the event stream:
  {"type":"auto","evaluated_permission":{"type":"allow"}}                               -> "allow"
  {"type":"auto","evaluated_permission":{"type":"ask","reason_code":"indeterminate"}}   -> "ask"
  {"type":"auto","evaluated_permission":{"type":"deny","reason_code":"high_risk"}}      -> "deny"

DENIAL: agent receives tool_result content `Permission to use {tool_name} has been denied.`
with is_error:true. Session keeps running. CLIENT CANNOT OVERRIDE — sending
user.tool_confirmation for an event whose evaluated_permission is not `ask` returns 400.

Anthropic on reason_code: "a value for your client to branch on and keep in audit records,
not text to display to end users."
